title: The Most Important Camera Setting You're Probably Not Using
excerpt: C1, C2 and C3 sit on your mode dial doing nothing. A working photographer argues they're the closest thing to a workflow game-changer he's found — here's how to put them to work.

title: 14 Landscape Photography Beliefs Worth Questioning
excerpt: You don't need a wide angle, exotic travel, or a tripod everywhere. Michael Scott walks through the myths that quietly shape what beginners buy, where they go, and how they judge their progress.

title: Sony's 20-70mm f/4 Might Be the Mountain Zoom to Beat
excerpt: Two lightweight Sony zooms went climbing to see which could replace a 24-70mm f/2.8. The wider one won — and AI denoising has quietly changed the f/4 math.
